name: Nakanojō (Japan)
description: A purple field charged at the centre with the Nakanojō town emblem in white: a stylised angular character of two halves, like the character 中.
history: Municipal flag of Nakanojō, a town in Gunma Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 January 1973.

features.role: Nakanojō town emblem — a stylised angular character of two halves, like the character 中
